title: Give core-3.x its own version, 4.0.0-SNAPSHOT, and deploy it
body:
`core-3.x` (the Platform 3.0 line from #12) builds the same version as main, 3.0.0-SNAPSHOT, and doesn't deploy. The shared workflow deploys only `main`, `master` and `N.x` branches unless `deploy_branch` is set, so run 38076413983 skipped its deploy job, and deploying would have overwritten main's SNAPSHOT anyway. The o3forms-omod 3.0.0-SNAPSHOT on mavenrepo is therefore main's Platform 2.7.7 build (published on 2026-09-03). A module built for Platform 3.0 can't use it, yet openmrs-module-patientdocuments' `core-3.x` pins `o3FormsVersion` to 3.0.0-SNAPSHOT and resolves exactly that build.

This gives `core-3.x` the next major, 4.0.0-SNAPSHOT, and adds it to `deploy_branch`. Main keeps 3.0.0-SNAPSHOT, which #6 gave it for Platform 2.7.x and Java 21 and which hasn't been released; the highest release is 2.3.0 and the 2.x branch is on 2.4.0-SNAPSHOT. `main` stays in the list so it keeps deploying.

- With this input, the shared `resolve-maven-deploy-params` step (run locally from openmrs-contrib-gha-workflows main) resolves `["main", "core-3.x"]` for a push to `core-3.x`. Without it, it resolves `["main", "master"]`.
- `mvn -U clean verify` passes on JDK 21 against the published core 3.0.0-SNAPSHOT (build 438) with a clean local repository, with 22 omod tests (the api module has none). The omod's config.xml says 4.0.0-SNAPSHOT.
- `bamboo-specs/bamboo.yml` still carries `maven.release.version: 3.0.0` / `maven.development.version: 3.1.0-SNAPSHOT`; it isn't touched here, since releases go through `release.yml`.

Modules that need o3forms' Platform 3.0 build move to 4.0.0-SNAPSHOT once this deploys, openmrs-module-patientdocuments' `core-3.x` among them.

title: Upgrade to support OpenMRS Platform 3.0
body:
Updates o3forms so it builds against, and runs on, openmrs-core master (Platform 3.0.0-SNAPSHOT: Java 21, Jakarta EE, Spring 7). The module version stays at main's 3.0.0-SNAPSHOT. Same approach as the platform 3 upgrades of calculation (openmrs/openmrs-module-calculation#19), legacyui and webservices.rest.

## Changes
- Versions:
  - `openmrsPlatformVersion` is now 3.0.0-SNAPSHOT and `webserviceRestVersion` is 5.0.0-SNAPSHOT.
  - `openmrs-bom` is imported, and the explicit commons-io version is dropped because the BOM manages it.
- Build:
  - Java 21 (`maven.compiler.release`).
  - `maven.compiler.parameters=true`, so that the controller's unnamed `@RequestParam` resolves on Spring 6+.
  - impsort is 1.13.0, since 1.6.2 fails on Java 21, and its groups include `jakarta`.
  - The formatter keeps its 2.7.7 tools config, so untouched code isn't reformatted.
- `O3FormsResourceController` uses `jakarta.servlet`. The explicit `javax.servlet-api` dependencies and the obsolete powermock/mockito-all/hamcrest-all exclusions are removed.
- CI: `release.yml` and the Bamboo jobs/images use JDK 21.
- Test fixture: `root-form-compiled.json` now expects `resourceVersion` inside `encounterType`. Since REST 3.1.0 (RESTWS-1012), custom representations include it.

## Verification
- `mvn clean install` passes (18 tests).
- I deployed the omod on openmrs-core master (`mvn jetty:run`, MySQL 8) with legacyui, webservices.rest 5.0.0-SNAPSHOT, fhir2 6.0.0-SNAPSHOT and calculation:
  - All modules started, and the server log has no errors from this module.
  - Logging in through the UI works.
  - `GET /ws/rest/v1/o3/forms/{uuid}` is served by the module's controller. For a form with no resources it returns the module's own "does not have any resources" response.

title: Separate OWASP dependency check into its own job
body:
## Summary
- Separate OWASP dependency check into a standalone workflow job
- OWASP check only runs on push and workflow_dispatch (not on PRs)
- Build job no longer runs the OWASP check inline or needs the NVD_API_KEY secret

## Test plan
- [ ] Verify build job still passes
- [ ] Verify OWASP dependency check runs on push to the default branch
- [ ] Verify OWASP dependency check does not run on pull requests

title: O3-5519: Add BOT_GH_TOKEN to build workflow secrets
body:
## Description
Ticket Link - https://openmrs.atlassian.net/browse/O3-5519
Ticket ID - O3-5519

## Summary
The shared OWASP Dependency Check workflow (openmrs-contrib-gha-workflows) has been updated to automatically push generated vulnerability reports to the central dashboard repository (openmrs-contrib-dependency-vulnerability-dashboard). To support this, the reusable workflow now requires the GH_BOT_TOKEN secret to be passed by calling repositories. Without it, the workflow cannot push reports to the dashboard.

## Change
Added `BOT_GH_TOKEN: ${{ secrets.OMRS_BOT_GH_TOKEN }}` to the secrets block in `.github/workflows/build.yml`.
